annotation_design_summary.memory_precondition: xizi_dll_node(linklist_head): non-null sentinel with exclusive value-opaque ownership of node_next and node_prev
annotation_design_summary.single_link_style_reference: xizi_sll_head also places head <> NULL inside the reusable public head predicate
